title: JANUS Gift: Undina's Comb for Roses

dedication.meaning: Named for the mythical comb of Undina and for the wave crest JANUS seeks to shape. Dedicated to the woman whose love and inspiration gave the mechanism its name.
dedication.spelling_rule: Use 'Undina' to preserve the direct personal and television-series reference; do not normalize it to 'Undine'.

mission: Discover any reproducible multi-pulse policy that creates a new controlled completion crest inside one live persistent process, then learn to place braking or shaping barriers ahead of the wave rather than chasing it from behind.
canonical_principles: JANUS must not chase the wave. It must know its speed and meet it ahead.
Do not stop the water; draw the comb through it so one controlled crest gives birth to the next.
A late compression command should be aborted when the predicted crest has already passed the useful barrier.
Hash quality must never steer pump, braking, or admission decisions.

canonical_terms.FOAM: visible residual work around or beyond a control boundary
canonical_terms.PRE_SHIFT_FOAM: work already completed before the shift command timestamp
canonical_terms.POST_SHIFT_FOAM: work completed after the shift command timestamp
canonical_terms.SHIFT_SPACE: remaining controllable space before the observed logical ceiling of 16
canonical_terms.TIMESHIFT: latency-compensated predictive placement of a future control barrier; not literal time manipulation

CREST_ESTIMATOR.role: Estimate present and predicted crest position, velocity, acceleration, in-flight pressure, and distance to the logical ceiling.
inputs: dispatch timestamp proxy or future native dispatch time

FOAM_METER.role: Measure total, pre-shift, and post-shift foam without redefining the strict causal classes.

TIMESHIFT_ENGINE.role: Estimate observe + decide + actuate latency and convert it into a lead distance measured in expected completions.
TIMESHIFT_ENGINE.decision_equation: lead_distance = expected completions during control latency + safety margin
TIMESHIFT_ENGINE.learning: Update lead distance from observed timing error; begin with transparent online calibration rather than opaque ML.

LEAD_BARRIER.role: Arm a soft admission hold ahead of the predicted crest. It must not kill already dispatched valid work.

TOO_LATE_ABORT.role: Suppress a compression command when predicted crest at actuation is already beyond the useful barrier.
TOO_LATE_ABORT.purpose: Avoid pointless shutdowns, extra foam, and observer races.

COMB_CONTROLLER.role: Generate and evaluate multi-pulse target/admission policies across arbitrary levels and thresholds, not a fixed 7→1→7 sequence.

OBSERVER_DRAIN_HANDSHAKE.role: Keep observer finalization alive after admission closes and seal only when prepared=0, orphan=0, finalized=exposure, unresolved=0.
OBSERVER_DRAIN_HANDSHAKE.rule: Compute admission, observer finalization, and process termination are separate phases.

pump_signature: a new dispatch/completion cluster after a measured decline
repeatable completion-rate reacceleration after a control pulse
in-flight recovery or new cohort admission after reopen
effect absent or materially smaller in matched sham
discovery_goal.success_limit: A single attractive trace is exploratory. Discovery requires preregistered replication with strict observer sealing.

search_strategy.phase_1: Broad low/mid/high level and trigger sweep to locate any responsive region.
search_strategy.phase_2: Local search around responsive amplitudes, lead distances, and dwell times.
search_strategy.phase_3: Repeated multi-pulse replication in one persistent process.

implementation_boundary.required: Persistent process with an internal admission gate or equivalent soft hold/reopen mechanism.
implementation_boundary.not_sufficient: External target number plus immediate CTRL_BREAK.

relationship_to_a18_41: A18.41 established the bounded wave, replicated upward continuation after 3→7, showed that external downward control usually arrives after most foam has formed, and validated fail-closed observer detection. A18.42 uses those measurements to create predictive lead control and multi-pulse discovery.
claim_limits: TimeShift is an engineering latency-compensation mechanism, not a physical time-shift claim.
The observed ceiling 16 is configuration-specific logical occupancy, not a universal constant.
No energy saving is claimed until measured.
